description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProductPurchased' which is a controller in the OpenCart admin extension for reporting on products purchased. It includes methods for displaying the report, saving settings, listing reports, and retrieving report data, indicating it is part of the backend reporting system.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: Controller class for managing the product purchased report in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main form for the product purchased report, initializing data and loading view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration settings for the report in the database.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the report view with report data, order statuses, and other relevant info.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report data view, used for AJAX or sub-requests.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data as a string in JSON format, includes filtering, pagination, and data retrieval.
